provenance.citation: Linke et al. (2019), Scientific Data 6:283, doi:10.1038/s41597-019-0300-6
provenance.resolution: 15 arc-second source grid (~500 m); Pfafstetter level 8
provenance.processing: Selected seven source IDs. Original coordinates retained; no simplification, clipping, dissolve or reprojection. Shapefile rings converted to GeoJSON with holes/multipart retained. Interior label anchors added.
provenance.limits: Source units are not named Paute or reservoir catchments. No claim of whole Paute basin, Mazar/Amaluza catchment, upstream contribution, or hydrological modeling. Areas are source SUB_AREA, not UP_AREA.
